description.zh: 实体属性，复杂值需要序列化为JSON字符串
description.en: The entity attributes. Complex values must be serialized into a JSON string.

description.zh: 自定义属性值，key为自定义属性标识，value最多一个值；空列表表示删除该属性值
description.en: The custom attribute values. Each key specifies a custom attribute, and its value is an array that can contain at most one item. To delete an attribute value, provide an empty array.

description.zh: 待更新实体 ID；实体名称、实体类型、父子关系由 ID 决定，不支持通过本接口修改
description.en: The ID of the entity to update. The entity name, entity type, and parent-child relationship are determined by the ID and cannot be modified using this operation.

descriptions.zh: 需要购买 DataWorks 专业版及以上版本才能使用。
descriptions.en: You must purchase DataWorks Professional Edition or a higher edition to use this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public update-meta-entity --id custom_entity-customer_api:api_001 --comment this_is_a_comment --attributes '[]' --custom-attributes '[]' --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
